text: 一手轻扶椅子，前后腿慢慢滑开
Hold the chair lightly and slowly slide your legs apart
膝盖弯成直角，脚底往天花板推
Keep your knee bent at a right angle and push your sole up
跪姿固定脚跟，身体一条直线慢慢往前倒
Kneeling Nordic Curl with Hand Push-Back
Kneel with heels anchored and fall forward slowly in one line
脚背贴地跪好，身体慢慢往后坐
Kneel with the tops of your feet down and slowly sit back
膝盖着地，从头到膝一条直线往下
Kneel and lower with your body straight from head to knees

Slide one hand palm-up under your other arm
双膝并拢，上面的手臂画个大弧往后打开
Keep your knees together and sweep your top arm back in a big arc
膝盖抬起，画一个你能做到的最大的圈
Lift your knee and draw the biggest circle you can

Keep one hand down and open your other arm toward the ceiling

Keep your back flat and rock your hips back toward your heels

Prop on your forearm and knee and lift your hips into a straight line

Lift both straight legs together with your lower back down

Keep elbows and hands on the floor and slide your arms toward your head

Slide your heel slowly away along the floor, then back

Hold a forearm side plank and lift the top leg

Sit your hips back, straighten the front leg and keep your back long
背部拉长，上身慢慢往前倾
Keep your back long and lean forward from your hips

Stand firm on one leg and slowly lift the other hip

Keep your elbow at your side and swing only your forearm out

Spread your knees wide and slowly sit your hips back

Squeeze your glute and slowly shift your body forward
Let your hips sink slowly forward and down
前腿小腿横在身前，后腿往后伸直
Bring your front shin across and stretch the back leg behind you
先把肩胛骨往下往后收，再抬手
Pull your shoulder blades down and back before you lift
腿伸直，一条腿抬离地面
Keep the leg straight and lift it off the floor

Reach one arm and the other leg long while your body stays still
膝盖保持弯曲，腿往侧面抬起
Keep your knee bent and lift the leg out to the side
